species.name: Treecko
species.flavor: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

species.name: Grovyle
species.flavor: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

species.name: Sceptile
species.flavor: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

species.name: Torchic
species.flavor: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

species.name: Combusken
species.flavor: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

species.name: Blaziken
species.flavor: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

species.name: Mudkip
species.flavor: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

species.name: Marshtomp
species.flavor: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

species.name: Swampert
species.flavor: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

species.name: Poochyena
species.flavor: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

species.name: Mightyena
species.flavor: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

species.name: Zigzagoon
species.flavor: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

species.name: Linoone
species.flavor: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

species.name: Wurmple
species.flavor: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

species.name: Silcoon
species.flavor: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

species.name: Beautifly
species.flavor: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

species.name: Cascoon
species.flavor: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

species.name: Dustox
species.flavor: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

species.name: Lotad
species.flavor: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

species.name: Lombre
species.flavor: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

species.name: Ludicolo
species.flavor: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

species.name: Seedot
species.flavor: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

species.name: Nuzleaf
species.flavor: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

species.name: Shiftry
species.flavor: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

species.name: Taillow
species.flavor: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.

species.name: Swellow
species.flavor: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

species.name: Wingull
species.flavor: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

species.name: Pelipper
species.flavor: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

species.name: Ralts
species.flavor: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

species.name: Kirlia
species.flavor: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

species.name: Gardevoir
species.flavor: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

species.name: Surskit
species.flavor: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

species.name: Masquerain
species.flavor: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

species.name: Shroomish
species.flavor: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

species.name: Breloom
species.flavor: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

species.name: Slakoth
species.flavor: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

species.name: Vigoroth
species.flavor: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.

species.name: Slaking
species.flavor: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.

species.name: Nincada
species.flavor: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

species.name: Ninjask
species.flavor: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

species.name: Shedinja
species.flavor: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

species.name: Whismur
species.flavor: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

species.name: Loudred
species.flavor: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

species.name: Exploud
species.flavor: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

species.name: Makuhita
species.flavor: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

species.name: Hariyama
species.flavor: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

species.name: Azurill
species.flavor: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

species.name: Nosepass
species.flavor: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

species.name: Skitty
species.flavor: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.

species.name: Delcatty
species.flavor: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.

species.name: Sableye
species.flavor: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

species.name: Mawile
species.flavor: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

species.name: Aron
species.flavor: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

species.name: Lairon
species.flavor: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

species.name: Aggron
species.flavor: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

species.name: Meditite
species.flavor: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

species.name: Medicham
species.flavor: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

species.name: Electrike
species.flavor: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

species.name: Manectric
species.flavor: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

species.name: Plusle
species.flavor: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

species.name: Minun
species.flavor: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

species.name: Volbeat
species.flavor: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

species.name: Illumise
species.flavor: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

species.name: Roselia
species.flavor: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

species.name: Gulpin
species.flavor: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

species.name: Swalot
species.flavor: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.

species.name: Carvanha
species.flavor: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

species.name: Sharpedo
species.flavor: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

species.name: Wailmer
species.flavor: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

species.name: Wailord
species.flavor: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

species.name: Numel
species.flavor: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

species.name: Camerupt
species.flavor: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

species.name: Torkoal
species.flavor: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

species.name: Spoink
species.flavor: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

species.name: Grumpig
species.flavor: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

species.name: Spinda
species.flavor: Its steps are shaky and stumbling. Walking for a long time makes it feel sick.

species.name: Trapinch
species.flavor: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

species.name: Vibrava
species.flavor: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

species.name: Flygon
species.flavor: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

species.name: Cacnea
species.flavor: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

species.name: Cacturne
species.flavor: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.

species.name: Swablu
species.flavor: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

species.name: Altaria
species.flavor: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

species.name: Zangoose
species.flavor: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

species.name: Seviper
species.flavor: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

species.name: Lunatone
species.flavor: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

species.name: Solrock
species.flavor: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

species.name: Barboach
species.flavor: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

species.name: Whiscash
species.flavor: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

species.name: Corphish
species.flavor: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

species.name: Crawdaunt
species.flavor: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

species.name: Baltoy
species.flavor: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

species.name: Claydol
species.flavor: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

species.name: Lileep
species.flavor: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

species.name: Cradily
species.flavor: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

species.name: Anorith
species.flavor: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

species.name: Armaldo
species.flavor: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

species.name: Feebas
species.flavor: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

species.name: Milotic
species.flavor: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

species.name: Castform
species.flavor: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

species.name: Kecleon
species.flavor: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

species.name: Shuppet
species.flavor: There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

species.name: Banette
species.flavor: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

species.name: Duskull
species.flavor: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

species.name: Dusclops
species.flavor: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

species.name: Tropius
species.flavor: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

species.name: Chimecho
species.flavor: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

species.name: Absol
species.flavor: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

species.name: Wynaut
species.flavor: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

species.name: Snorunt
species.flavor: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

species.name: Glalie
species.flavor: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

species.name: Spheal
species.flavor: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

species.name: Sealeo
species.flavor: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

species.name: Walrein
species.flavor: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

species.name: Clamperl
species.flavor: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

species.name: Huntail
species.flavor: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

species.name: Gorebyss
species.flavor: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

species.name: Relicanth
species.flavor: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

species.name: Luvdisc
species.flavor: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

species.name: Bagon
species.flavor: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

species.name: Shelgon
species.flavor: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

species.name: Salamence
species.flavor: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

species.name: Beldum
species.flavor: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

species.name: Metang
species.flavor: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

species.name: Metagross
species.flavor: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

species.name: Regirock
species.flavor: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

species.name: Regice
species.flavor: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

species.name: Registeel
species.flavor: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

species.name: Latias
species.flavor: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

species.name: Latios
species.flavor: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

species.name: Kyogre
species.flavor: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

species.name: Groudon
species.flavor: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

species.name: Rayquaza
species.flavor: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

species.name: Jirachi
species.flavor: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

species.name: Deoxys
species.flavor: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
